WITH sex_averages AS (
  SELECT p.SEX, AVG(1.0 * l.CPK / l.GPT) AS avg_ratio
  FROM Laboratory AS l
  JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE l.CPK IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT <> 0
  GROUP BY p.SEX
),
first_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM sex_averages
),
above_first AS (
  SELECT s.SEX, s.avg_ratio, f.mean_ratio
  FROM sex_averages AS s
  CROSS JOIN first_mean AS f
  WHERE s.avg_ratio > f.mean_ratio
),
second_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM above_first
),
left_sexes AS (
  SELECT a.avg_ratio, a.mean_ratio AS first_mean, m.mean_ratio AS second_mean
  FROM above_first AS a
  CROSS JOIN second_mean AS m
  WHERE a.avg_ratio > m.mean_ratio
)
SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS average_ratio,
       AVG(avg_ratio - first_mean) AS average_above_first_mean,
       AVG(avg_ratio - second_mean) AS average_above_second_mean
FROM left_sexes
